PHILOSOPHY_FLOOR_LIBERATION_CG_INTRO.tex:
Then, in the middle of all the chaotic cries, someone shouted:
“It’s the beast! A big, scary monster lives in the black, dusky forest!”
PHILOSOPHY_FLOOR_LIBERATION_CG_BIG_EYES_: Big Bird’s far seeing eyes were blinded,
PHILOSOPHY_FLOOR_LIBERATION_CG_SMALL_BEA: Small Bird’s mouth that could devour anything was shut,
PHILOSOPHY_FLOOR_LIBERATION_CG_LONG_ARMS: The head that always gazed upon the cosmos was lowered,
PHILOSOPHY_FLOOR_LIBERATION_CG_VICTORY.t:
The bird began to prowl the forest, but there was nothing.
There were no creatures, no sun and moon, and no beast. All that was left was just a bird and the Black Forest.
